capabilities: Suppress inline tag recognition in note body text
Render inline #word tokens as plain text without tag styling or click behavior
Exclude inline tags from the tag pane and tag search
Keep frontmatter YAML tags working normally
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author built it so that users who tag exclusively in frontmatter properties can keep their tag namespace clean of stray inline # symbols like issue numbers or heading references.
problem: By default every #word in body text becomes a tag, so incidental # symbols pollute the tag pane and tag search for users who organize with frontmatter tags only.
summary: Tag-recognition modifier that stops Obsidian from treating #word in note bodies as tags, keeping only frontmatter-defined tags.
